item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find reliable 2024 evidence of a broad, Erdoğan-led accountability drive that systematically punished police, gendarmes, intelligence services, or prison officials for abuse. The positive evidence is limited to isolated or delayed court action, not a general pattern of prevention or punishment.","evidence":[{"title":"World Report 2024: Türkiye","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024","url":"https://www.hrw.org/world-report/2024/country-chapters/turkey","summary":"HRW says torture and ill-treatment in police/gendarmerie custody and prisons have rarely been rigorously investigated and even more rarely prosecuted; it also reports post-earthquake beatings and a death in gendarmerie custody.","question_ids":["3B.2","3B.1"]},{"title":"UN Body to Examine Türkiye’s Record on Torture","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-07-16","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/07/16/un-body-examine-turkiyes-record-torture-0","summary":"HRW says Türkiye’s torture record deteriorated greatly and that impunity persists; this is a direct indictment of failure to prevent or punish abuse by security forces.","question_ids":["3B.2","3B.1"]},{"title":"UN Body to Examine Türkiye’s Record on Torture","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-07-16","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/07/16/un-body-examine-turkiyes-record-torture-0","summary":"The same HRW report notes a rare exception: after years of delay, three police officers and a doctor were finally set to face trial in the Eyüp Birinci torture case. This is evidence of some accountability, but only as an outlier.","question_ids":["3B.2"]},{"title":"Submission by Human Rights Watch on Türkiye to the Human Rights Committee","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-10-23","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/10/23/submission-human-rights-watch-turkiye-human-rights-committee","summary":"HRW says there was little evidence of effective investigations into enforced disappearances, and some victims may have been pressured not to file complaints.","question_ids":["3B.2","3B.1"]},{"title":"Türkiye: Kurdish Politicians Convicted in Unjust Mass Trial","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-05-16","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/05/16/turkiye-kurdish-politicians-convicted-unjust-mass-trial","summary":"A Turkish court convicted 24 Kurdish politicians on bogus state-security charges in what HRW calls a manifestly political and unjust trial, with continued detention for many defendants.","question_ids":["3B.2"]},{"title":"Türkiye: Gezi Park defendants must be acquitted, and the chronicle of injustice brought to an end","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-12-09","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/press-release/2024/12/turkiye-gezi-park-defendants-must-be-acquitted-and-the-chronicle-of-injustice-brought-to-an-end/","summary":"Amnesty says the Gezi prosecutions were politically motivated repression, with baseless charges sustained over years instead of lawful accountability.","question_ids":["3B.2"]}]}
